## Core Specializations & 12 Key Services
1. **IT Consulting**: Strategic technology roadmaps, cloud architecture advisement, system auditing, tech-stack evaluation, and digital transformation for startups and established enterprises.
2. **Software Development**: Custom, scalable enterprise software solutions engineered with Python, Django, Odoo ERP custom modules, Node.js, and TypeScript.
3. **Website Development**: High-performance, mobile-responsive, modern business websites engineered for speed, conversions, and clean UI/UX.
4. **Web Application Development**: Complex web apps, SaaS dashboards, and portal architectures using Next.js, React.js, and Django REST framework.
5. **Mobile Application Development**: Cross-platform mobile applications for iOS and Android with intuitive interfaces and robust backend integration.
6. **E-Commerce Development**: Custom e-commerce platforms, checkout optimization, inventory management, and secure multi-currency payment gateway integrations.
7. **Search Engine Optimization (SEO)**: On-page SEO, semantic keyword ranking, high-intent lead generation, and Google search visibility strategies.
8. **Technical SEO & Website Optimization**: Core Web Vitals optimization, schema markup (JSON-LD), page speed acceleration, mobile indexing, and server response tuning.
9. **CRM Development**: Custom Customer Relationship Management & Odoo ERP systems (v14-v18), core app customization (Sales, CRM, Purchase, Inventory, Invoicing, HR), lead tracking pipelines, customer data unification, and WhatsApp/email communication integrations.
10. **Business Process Automation**: Workflow automation eliminating manual bottlenecks, Odoo automated actions, scheduled task orchestration, webhook integrations, and data synchronization (including Tally data migrations).
11. **API Development & Integration**: High-throughput REST & GraphQL APIs, third-party API integrations (Meta Graph API, WhatsApp Business API, Stripe, Razorpay, Odoo XML-RPC).
12. **Website Maintenance**: Ongoing 24/7 security patching, performance monitoring, database backups, uptime maintenance, and feature enhancements.
